summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into victory at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez, crossing the line ahead of Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari to secure his fourth consecutive world title. The result mathematically confirmed Kimi Antonelli as Formula 1's youngest world champion, with the McLaren driver clinching the drivers' championship before the chequered flag fell. Verstappen's win extends Red Bull's lead in the constructors' battle while Hamilton's runner-up finish marks an encouraging result in his opening months with the Scuderia.
